title: India thrash South Korea 8-1 to reach Asian Champions Trophy hockey final against Japan
dek: Dilpreet Singh and Shilanand Lakra score twice each in Mohali. India meet Japan in the competition's first final between the two sides on Thursday at 7 pm.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
India will play Japan in the final of the men's Asian Champions Trophy in Mohali on Thursday evening after beating South Korea 8-1 in Wednesday's semi-final, their second big win over the Koreans in three days.

The hosts were 3-1 up at the end of the first quarter and 6-1 ahead at half-time at the Olympian Balbir Singh International Stadium, reports said. Two days earlier, in their last league match in Jalandhar, they had beaten the same opponents 8-0. The final, the first between India and Japan in the competition's history, is scheduled for 7 pm IST, according to Olympics.com.

## The semi-final

Shilanand Lakra opened the scoring in the fourth minute, and Han Sangjun equalised for Korea in the eighth with a sudden burst of pace, the only time the visitors troubled India. Harmanpreet Singh scored in the 10th minute and Shilanand added his second from a penalty corner in the 13th. Sukhjeet Singh and Dilpreet Singh both scored in the 21st minute, and Dilpreet got another in the 25th. Angad Bir Singh (36th) and Vivek Sagar Prasad (54th) completed the scoring after the break.

The pace dropped in the third quarter, and Korean goalkeeper Kim Jaehyeon made several saves to keep the score down, one report said. Korea are rebuilding with a young squad that includes only five players from the side that played at the recent Asian Games.

## Japan's route

Japan reached their third Asian Champions Trophy final, and their first since 2021, by beating higher-ranked Malaysia 5-3 in a shoot-out after a goalless 60 minutes. It was their second win in a row over Malaysia. Goalkeeper Takumi Kitagawa was outstanding as Malaysia failed to convert five penalty corners, and Japan captain Raiki Fujishima hit the post with a penalty corner in the 57th minute.

In the match for fifth place, China beat Bangladesh 3-1.

## What is at stake

India have reached seven Asian Champions Trophy finals and are seeking a sixth title, reports said.

## Results

- Semi-final: India 8 (Shilanand Lakra 4, 13; Harmanpreet Singh 10; Sukhjeet Singh 21; Dilpreet Singh 21, 25; Angad Bir Singh 36; Vivek Sagar Prasad 54) beat South Korea 1 (Han Sangjun 8)
- Semi-final: Japan 0 drew with Malaysia 0; Japan won the shoot-out 5-3
- Fifth place: China 3 beat Bangladesh 1
- Final: India vs Japan, Thursday 5 November, 7 pm IST, Mohali
